description:
Part of the webhook audit trail epic; read the epic first. Deferred: do after the PR ticket, when Matt asks.

## Goal

Record the rest of the useful webhook facts in Postgres. The raw deliveries are already archived from the first ticket.

1. Trust gate changes: `installation` (created, deleted, suspend, unsuspend, new_permissions_accepted) and `installation_repositories` (added, removed). Every GitHub App receives these without subscribing. They are fleet-level, not per run: a small append-only table (who: sender.login, when, action, installation id, repositories added/removed) and a dashboard page. The installation is Agbredo's only trust gate (docs/10-design.md, Trust), so changes to it belong in the audit trail.
2. Questions filed by agents in bw: pushes by a bot to the `beadwork` branch (`push` event, needs Contents: read). To link them to a run, bw's commit message must carry the run ID; bw controls those messages, so first find out whether bw can add a trailer (or the pipeline can amend), and talk with Matt.
3. Changes to a deployment's caller workflow file (`push` touching .github/workflows/<file>) and tag moves in the central pipelines repo (needs the App installed there). Ask Matt whether wanted.

## Open questions for Matt

Which of the three, and in what order.
title: Record installation changes, beadwork pushes and workflow edits from webhooks
